items.title: Wendy Oxenhorn interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 22, 2026
items.q: I think that was Rick White from Festival Productions and Dan Melnick.

ctx.x: Who was in charge of assembling the combos, the combinations of people?

I think that was Rick White from Festival Productions and Dan Melnick. Yeah. Rick White was amazing. I think he’s teaching at Columbia. But yeah, it was just – and honestly you know how things like that happen. It was – it just happened. You know? And you get all those people coming together, the reunion that was happening backstage. And I remember I got this photographer, John Abbott, and I still have yet to ask him for a copy or I lost it over the years, but I asked him to do a photo of a Great Night in Harlem…
I sort of know what you mean. I’ve been in company with some of these people like Milt Hinton and there’s something about their glow, they’re like magnets.
